  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "Eagles (Latin aquila, via Old French egle); Death (Old English dēaþ, from Proto-Germanic *dauþuz); Metal (Greek metallon, via Latin metallum)",
    "reading": "The high-soaring bird of empire meets the end of being and the mined substance of transformation",
    "languages": ["en", "la", "grc", "fr", "de"],
    "source": "Oxford English Dictionary; Lewis & Short Latin Dictionary",
    "confidence": 0.8
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "Ea + gles; gles (French 'glace' = ice); of (English 'off'); Death (German 'Tod'); Metal (French 'métal')",
    "reading": "Ice-bird, off the death-metal: a cold flight severed from the ringing ore",
    "languages": ["en", "fr", "de"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.6
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "Eagles → 'aigles' (French eagles); Death → 'dette' (French debt) + 'h' silent; Metal → 'métal' (French) but also 'met alle' (Dutch: with all)",
    "reading": "Eagles of debt with all: the soaring ones carry an unpaid weight, wholly together",
    "languages": ["en", "fr", "nl"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "Eagles of Death Metal → 'Death of Eagles Metal' → 'Metal Death of Eagles' → rearrange to 'Gleed, foam, hate, slate' (Gleed = glowing coal; slate = writing stone)",
    "reading": "Glowing coal and foam, hate and slate: the song of fire, water, anger, and inscription",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "notariqon",
    "chain": "E.O.D.M. → Latin 'Ex Ordine Divino Metallorum' (from the divine order of metals); also 'Ego Omnia Deo Mando' (I entrust all to God)",
    "reading": "From the divine order of metals, all is entrusted to God: a sacred alchemical decree",
    "languages": ["la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "E (eagle, spirit) + A (alpha, beginning) + G (gamma, generation) + L (lamed, ox-goad) + E (end) + S (sigma, sum); Death = D (delta, change) + E (epsilon) + A + T (tau, cross) + H (heta, breath); Metal = M (mem, water) + E + T + A + L (lamed)",
    "reading": "Spirit begins, generation goads, end sums; change breathes through the cross; water and ox-goad forge the ore",
    "languages": ["en", "he", "grc"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "numerical",
    "chain": "E(5)+A(1)+G(7)+L(12)+E(5)+S(19) = 49; Death = D(4)+E(5)+A(1)+T(20)+H(8) = 38; Metal = M(13)+E(5)+T(20)+A(1)+L(12) = 51; total 138 → 1+3+8=12 → 1+2=3",
    "reading": "The sum reduces to three: the trinity of sky, end, and earth — a ternary of completion",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "Death (Old English dēaþ, from Proto-Indo-European *dheu- = to die, also 'dust'); Metal (Greek metallon = mine, quarry, from *metalleuein = to search after)",
    "reading": "Dust and quarry: the search after what is dug from the ground, ending in dust",
    "languages": ["en", "grc", "ine"],
    "source": "Oxford English Dictionary; Liddell-Scott Greek Lexicon",
    "confidence": 0.7
  }
]
